101.title: Data Science Lead (Remote)
101.description: Lead a team of data scientists focusing on predictive modeling and customer segmentation. This role requires expertise in **Machine Learning (ML)** pipelines and extensive experience with Python, TensorFlow, and large-scale data processing on AWS. We offer an unparalleled opportunity for high-impact work and full remote flexibility.

102.title: Junior Frontend Developer
102.description: Join our fast-paced creative team to build beautiful, responsive user interfaces. You must be proficient in React and modern CSS, ideally with experience using Tailwind CSS. While a desire to learn **TypeScript** is required, full proficiency is not expected immediately. This is an on-site role in our Manhattan office, offering great mentoring opportunities.

103.title: Backend API Engineer (Go/Python)
103.description: We are looking for a backend specialist to build and maintain high-performance, low-latency APIs. Core languages are Go and Python. Deep knowledge of SQL databases like PostgreSQL is essential for optimizing complex queries. Experience with cloud deployment using **Docker and Kubernetes** is a must-have for this hybrid role.
